Use a title prefix such as `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `build:`, or `i18n:` for automatic labeling.

## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or workflow improvement
- [ ] Format or engine integration
- [ ] Translation or documentation
- [ ] Build, packaging, or CI

## Validation

List the OS, architecture, engine versions, and checks actually run. Mark unavailable checks as not run.

- [ ] Non-engine pytest
- [ ] Native CTest
- [ ] Relevant engine integration or app workflow

For coordinate or timing changes, include non-rest-pose results and numerical errors.
For UI changes, include screenshots and check saved language selection and RTL.

## Checklist

- [ ] UI text is synchronized across all 15 locale catalogs when applicable.
- [ ] New dependencies have license and source notices in `packaging/`.
- [ ] No commercial assets, private paths, credentials, or generated projects are included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the behavior and verification limits.
